_README: Human-editable seed list of Mayor Mamdani's on-the-record appearances on sources OTHER than nyc.gov and the Mayor's Office YouTube channel. scrape_external.py reads this, fetches each item's published transcript, and adds it to the corpus. Discovery on these sources can't be fully automated (search pages are JavaScript-rendered and bot-gated), so this curated list is the reliable backbone. Add an entry and the next refresh ingests it. Fields: source (npr|wnyc|cspan|podcast), id (the source-specific identifier the fetcher needs), and optional title/date/note used only if the page doesn't supply them.
